title: U.S. annual household income
definition: Official SCF INCOME: total household income for calendar year 2024 before taxes, including the specified IRA and tax-deferred pension withdrawals, adjusted to 2025 dollars. The official aggregate floors base income at zero; no additional clipping is applied here.

source.name: Federal Reserve Survey of Consumer Finances

method: Weighted empirical CDF, at or below; average of five separately normalized weighted CDFs using extract WGT (already X42001/5). No interpolation across point masses.
